description: This file defines interfaces for managing network device traffic metrics, including setting and getting harvesting statuses, reporting and polling periods, TTL settings, and managing IP table data. It contains function prototypes, macros, and include guards specific to network device traffic configuration.

methods.name: SetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for network devices. Returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for network devices. Returns true if enabled, false if disabled.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for network device scans, in seconds. Returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for network device scans.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for network device scans, in seconds. Returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default TTL value for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateNDTPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value falls within the acceptable range.

methods.name: SetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL interval for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL interval for network device scans.

methods.name: isvalueinarray_ndt
methods.description: Checks if a given value is present in an array of ULONGs.
